mappings.note: Contains only the superscription (To the choir director...), which is not present in OSMAIN v1 text body. OSMAIN starts with 'Da edomitten Doeg kom...'.
Contains the historical note ('When Doeg came...') which is only part of OSMAIN v1. The rest of OSMAIN v1 (the psalm text starting 'Why do you boast...') continues in translation verse 3.
Contains the first part of OSMAIN v1 ('Why do you boast... God's faithfulness lasts all day'). The historical note from translation verse 2 is missing here.
Matches OSMAIN v2 ('Your tongue plots destruction...').
Matches OSMAIN v3 ('You love evil more than good... Selah').
Matches OSMAIN v4 ('You love all destructive words...').
Matches OSMAIN v5 ('So God will tear you down... Selah').
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('The righteous shall see it and fear...'). Note: The Hebrew text in wlc includes 'and they will laugh at him' which is the end of this verse.
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('Behold, he who did not make God his refuge...').
Matches OSMAIN v8 ('But I am like a green olive tree...').
Matches OSMAIN v9 ('I will thank you forever...').

extraContent.description: Superscription: 'To the choir director. A maskil of David.' This text is present in wlc but missing from the OSMAIN verse numbering provided (which starts with the narrative/historical note).
